Package domain.controller.generationAlgorithm

Class GenerationAlgorithm

java.lang.Object
domain.controller.generationAlgorithm.GenerationAlgorithm
Direct Known Subclasses:
BasicGenerator
public abstract class GenerationAlgorithm extends Object
Abstract base class for Hidato puzzle generation algorithms. Implementations of this class are responsible for: generating new hidatos given some constraints and converting a complete hidato into a solvable puzzle by hiding cells according to its difficulty.

  • Method Details

    • generateHidato

      public abstract String generateHidato(String topology, Adjacency ad, int nC, Difficulty dif)
      Generates a puzzle. It is a complete, solved Hidato where numbers 1 through nC (or fewer if generation stops early) are placed sequentially on the board. The puzzle must respect the given topology, adjacency mode, and approximate cell count.
      Parameters:
      topology - Topology code: "Q" (Square), "T" (Triangle), or "H" (Hexagon).
      ad - Adjacency mode.
      nC - Requested approximate number of cells to place.
      dif - Difficulty level to apply during generation.
      Returns:
      A valid string representation of the solved hidato (header + board) or null if it was not capable to generate it.

    • makeSolvable

      public abstract String makeSolvable(String solution, Difficulty dif, int nC)
      Converts a complete Hidato solution into a solvable puzzle by hiding cells according to the specified difficulty level.
      Parameters:
      solution - A string representation of the complete solved Hidato.
      dif - Difficulty level. The easier, the fewer emptied cells.
      nC - Total number of cells in the solution.
      Returns:
      A string representation of the solvable puzzle.
